server.json.description: Stock analysis MCP server with market data, technical indicators, and AI research tools.
server.json.name: io.github.wshobson/maverick-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Optional database URL. Defaults to SQLite (sqlite:///maverick.db) if not provided. PostgreSQL supported for better performance.
environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional Redis host for enhanced caching performance. Defaults to in-memory caching if not provided.
environmentVariables.name: REDIS_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Optional Redis port (default: 6379)
environmentVariables.name: REDIS_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Optional LLM provider for the research extra (e.g. anthropic, openai, openai_compatible). Required only to enable research agent tools; bring your own API key.
environmentVariables.name: LLM_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: Optional API key for the configured LLM_PROVIDER. Required only when LLM_PROVIDER is set.
environmentVariables.name: LLM_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional model name for the configured LLM_PROVIDER. Required only when LLM_PROVIDER is set.
environmentVariables.name: LLM_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Optional base URL override, required when LLM_PROVIDER=openai_compatible.
environmentVariables.name: LLM_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional sampling temperature for the configured LLM_PROVIDER. Defaults to 0.0.
environmentVariables.name: LLM_TEMPERATURE

environmentVariables.description: Optional API key for Exa web search (research extra). Get at https://exa.ai
environmentVariables.name: EXA_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional research search backend: exa (default) or searxng.
environmentVariables.name: RESEARCH_SEARCH_BACKEND

environmentVariables.description: Optional base URL of a self-hosted SearXNG instance with the JSON format enabled; used when RESEARCH_SEARCH_BACKEND=searxng.
environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_BASE_URL

setup_instructions: Install dependencies: uv sync (or pip install -e .)
Start server: make dev (or uv run python -m maverick.server --transport http --port 8003)
Connect via mcp-remote: npx mcp-remote http://localhost:8003/mcp
